verdict.rationale: Jan is fundamentally a chat interface where users interact via natural-language prompts to control local/cloud models, custom assistants with persona instructions, and agentic tasks (files, commands, web research, MCP tool calls) — all driven by conversational input rather than rigid commands. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of natural-language command breadth and no example transcripts showing complex multi-step NL-driven task execution.
